headline: Is Synchrony Financial (SYF) A Bargain As Its Stripe CareCredit Checkout Deal Expands Reach?
summary: Synchrony Financial (SYF) just announced a new integration with Stripe that brings CareCredit financing directly into Stripe checkouts for health and wellness providers. This move puts financing options closer to where patients actually pay. See our latest analysis for Synchrony Financial. Synchrony Financial's latest Stripe partnership comes after an active few weeks that included multiple fixed income offerings in late July, while the stock trades at US$78.67 with a 30 day share price...

headline: Embedding CareCredit into Stripe’s Platform Could Be A Game Changer For Synchrony Financial (SYF)
summary: In late July and early August 2026, Synchrony Financial announced and then completed US$1.10 billion of callable, senior unsecured fixed-to-floating rate notes and integrated its CareCredit financing into Stripe’s platform for U.S. health and wellness providers’ online checkouts. This combination of fresh funding and embedded CareCredit access for over 12 million cardholders on Stripe could meaningfully deepen Synchrony’s presence in health and wellness financing while simplifying operations...
